model_annotation: This donut chart visually represents two categorical distributions using concentric rings: the outer ring shows the distribution of “Ambiguity Std” with four categories labeled “Std: 0.0” (dark blue, 49.0%), “Std: 0.47” (medium blue, 47.7%), “Std: 0.82” (light blue, 7.0%), and “Std: 0.94” (lightest blue, 5.0%); the inner ring displays the distribution of “Max Ambiguity” with three categories labeled “Max: 1” (light blue, 38.0%), “Max: 2” (medium blue, 39.0%), and “Max: 3” (lightest blue, 14.2%). The chart includes two legends: one for the outer ring titled “Ambiguity Std (Outer)” and one for the inner ring titled “Max Ambiguity (Inner)”, which map the colors to their respective categories. Percentage values are clearly labeled within each segment of both rings, and the segments appear to be arranged in descending order of size from left to right for both rings.
